summary: Iteration 500 — Tested 24-Hour Pickup dashboard widget + Stripe Pay-by-Link (backend + frontend). Backend: 9/9 pytest passing. Frontend: pickup card renders with real data (35 rooms sold, 47.8% pickup, £11255.81 revenue, +35 trend, source chips, expandable sold-rooms list); Stripe Link modal opens on unpaid booking rows, creates real Stripe checkout URL, populates link history with pending status; /payment/cancel and /payment/success pages render with correct testids and polling behavior. Two frontend issues to report: (1) uncaught runtime error overlay from navigator.clipboard.writeText permission-denied when auto-copying link, (2) many stripe-link buttons have testid 'stripe-link-undefined' because booking_ref is empty for demo bookings.

minor.issue: Route conflict: existing route in routes/finance_ext/payments.py (registered at server.py:437) shadows the new one in pay_by_link.py (registered at server.py:784). The old handler ALWAYS returns 200 (even for unknown session_id returns 200 with status=error, payment_status=unknown) and uses emergentintegrations StripeCheckout which cannot resolve sessions created directly via stripe.checkout.Session.create in pay_by_link.py — result: polling of pay-by-link sessions returns payment_status='unknown' from Stripe error instead of 'pending'. Frontend still renders as 'checking/processing' because 'unknown' is not in the terminal set, but the pending flow never resolves via polling. Fix: rename the new route path or share a single handler.

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught runtime error overlay: 'Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied.' The auto-copy call `navigator.clipboard?.writeText(data.checkout_url)` at StripeLinkModal.js:28 (and line 79) returns a Promise that rejects in the preview iframe/permissions context. Wrap with `.catch(()=>{})` or check `document.hasFocus()` first. This creates a full-screen webpack error overlay that blocks all subsequent user clicks (including stripe-check-status-0).

Most Stripe Link buttons have data-testid='stripe-link-undefined' because demo bookings have no booking_ref. Use booking.id fallback: `data-testid={`stripe-link-${booking.booking_ref || booking.id}`}` to keep testids unique.

integration_issues.issue: Due to backend route conflict above, polling never resolves to 'paid' even after real payment because the shadowed route reads Stripe via a different code path. Verifying-your-payment state persists (visually acceptable as 'processing').

action_items: Fix route conflict for /api/payments/status/{session_id} — either rename the pay_by_link.py route (e.g. /api/pay-links/status/{session_id}) or make old route delegate for pay-by-link kind sessions.
Wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText in StripeLinkModal.js (lines 28 and 79) with .catch to prevent uncaught promise rejection error overlay.
Use booking.id as fallback in data-testid for stripe-link buttons in BookingEnginePanel.
Consider populating booking_ref for existing demo bookings that lack one (cosmetic — pickup card sold-rooms list shows blank ref).
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering matters: same path defined in two include_routers → later one is silently ignored by FastAPI. Consider assertion/registry check at startup.
pay_by_link.py: create_link ignores decimal precision by rounding amount*100 — acceptable but note that Stripe amount rounding for GBP may need banker's rounding for tax-inclusive scenarios.
StripeLinkModal: any clipboard/permissioned API call must be user-gesture-scoped AND error-swallowed to avoid dev overlay in embedded previews.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (4/5 flows fully clean; StripeLinkModal has uncaught clipboard error overlay)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo bookings and Stripe test keys.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend Stripe Link modal successfully creates real Stripe test-mode checkout URLs and history renders. Backend pickup and pay-links CREATE + LIST all pass. Two known issues: (1) clipboard write throws uncaught error → wrap in .catch (2) /api/payments/status route conflict causes 'unknown' payment_status for pay_by_link sessions. Do not attempt real card payments; pending state is sufficient.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) Clipboard error: navigator.clipboard.writeText returns a rejected Promise in the sandboxed preview iframe (no user activation / permissions-policy) but the call is unhandled → React devtools/webpack overlay surfaces it as an uncaught runtime error, blocking pointer events. Fix: `.catch(()=>{})` on both calls. 2) Route conflict: FastAPI include_router registers first match wins; pay_by_link's GET /payments/status/{session_id} is shadowed by payments.py's earlier registration. The old handler uses emergentintegrations.StripeCheckout which does not know about sessions created via raw stripe.checkout.Session.create → Stripe lookup returns 'No such checkout.session' style error → response `payment_status: 'unknown'`, `status: 'error'` even for VALID new sessions. Mitigation: rename new endpoint path OR add early-return branch in old handler that detects `kind=='pay_by_link'` records and uses raw stripe.Session.retrieve.
